notes: Mobile Harness Code — v1.10.0: Template Library now ships 100+ admin dashboard templates. Browse, search, filter by industry, preview, and turn any template into a signed Android APK in one tap. Compose, XML, Web App, ZIP import, Android SDK, PRoot, Gradle and release flows are unchanged. This APK is SIGNED (V3-only, production key); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
